# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_PARAM_KEEPER_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-07-16  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK setup, when tuned with the keeper parameters, captures edge on J winner days without adding losses on J loser days (losers_added=0.0). The edge arises from selecting high-quality level breaks with volume confirmation and specific body characteristics, avoiding trades on loser days through parameter constraints.

## Mechanism

**Entry triggers when all conditions are met:**  
- Volume ≥ 1.3 × 20-bar average volume (vol_mult=1.3)  
- Candle body size ≥ $0.05 (body_min_cents=0.05)  
- Quality score ≥ 2 stars (min_stars=2)  
- Strike offset = ITM-2 for puts (strike_offset=2, assuming put context for J alignment)  
- Price within $1.50 of the broken level (proximity_dollars=1.5)  
- Break must occur above the open price (require_break_above_open=true)  

**Exit logic:**  
- Premium stop: -8% (premium_stop_pct=-0.08)  
- TP1: +40% profit target on 66.7% of position (tp1_premium_pct=0.4, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667)  
- Runner target: +150% profit target (runner_target_pct=1.5)  
- Profit lock: arms immediately at any profit (profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0) with 5% trailing offset (profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05)  
- Quantity: 10 contracts per trade
